uncited_review.passage: and salvation comes from this world of being and corruption.
And this is the knowledge around which they revolve, and toward which they incline.
Woe to you — could I worship a God I had not seen? How could I worship a God without having seen Him?
The eyes did not see Him by the witnessing of sight; rather the hearts saw Him by the realities of faith.
And the expression about Him by Allah, the Exalted, and by the Originator, with the exalted Ipseity — these two names and the attribute do not fall upon Him.
For names and attributes do not fall except upon their like.
Names and attributes are an indication pointing to the named one.
And the originated thing does not fall upon its originator as its like.
In that, they are equal — the powerful and the overpowered, the sensed and the intelligible, from both worlds together.
So he expressed about Him by what belonged to the attributes of His origination and His act.
Can you eat everything? You have the power to eat — so eat this filth set before you.
